_comment: Suggested talent builds, one per class and spec.
PROVENANCE - read this before trusting a build.
These are NOT usage statistics. OctoWoW publishes no armory (/armory is 403), there is no log
aggregator that covers it, and the class forums carry bug reports and balance suggestions
rather than per-spec guides. Nothing on this server measures what people actually play, so a
'most popular build' figure would have to be invented, and an invented number that looks
measured is worse than no number at all.
What these are instead: the long-settled Vanilla 1.12 and Turtle WoW build for each spec,
translated onto OctoWoW's own trees. That translation is real work, because the trees differ.
Stormstrike is one point here, not the top of a 30-point climb. Elemental Devastation grants
hit rather than crit. Whole talents - Master Strike, Ancestral Guardian, Precision Cut, Blade
Rush - have no vanilla counterpart at all.
Each build therefore carries two fields the UI shows the player:
'basis'    - the vanilla/Turtle build it descends from.
'diverges' - the choices that are OctoWoW-specific, i.e. where tradition ran out and the
pick was made from the talent's own text. These are the points most worth
arguing with, and the UI marks them.
FORMAT
'points' is keyed by tree name, then by talent name, both exactly as data/talents.json spells
them. Names rather than cell ids, so this file stays readable and reviewable by a player.
Duplicate names across trees (shaman Ancestral Knowledge, rogue Throwing Weapon
Specialization) are unambiguous because the tree name qualifies them.
Every build here is checked by the build tests against the real trees: names must exist, ranks
must not exceed the maximum, tier requirements and prerequisites must be satisfiable in some
order, and the total must not exceed 51. A build that fails is a build no player could train.

arms.name: Two-Handed Arms
diverges: Master of Arms replaces vanilla's per-weapon Axe/Sword/Mace specialisations, so it is taken regardless of weapon type - and it needs one point in Master Strike to unlock.
Boundless Anger has no vanilla equivalent; three points there are what carry the build up to Mortal Strike's tier.

fury.name: Dual-Wield Fury
diverges: Improved Shouts is filler to reach Flurry's tier; vanilla reached it through Improved Battle Shout, which is not in this tree.

protection.name: Shield Slam Protection
diverges: Defensive Tactics is OctoWoW-only and is taken partly because it is the cheapest route to Concussion Blow's tier.
Improved Shield Slam did not exist in vanilla; it follows Shield Slam directly.

holy.name: Holy Shock Healer
diverges: Ironclad takes a single point purely to reach Daybreak's tier - there is no vanilla talent in that position.
Daybreak itself is OctoWoW-only.

protection.name: Holy Shield Protection
diverges: Righteous Strikes and Bulwark of the Righteous are OctoWoW-only; the two points in Righteous Strikes exist to open Bulwark's tier.
Shield Specialization here requires five points in Redoubt first, which vanilla did not demand.

retribution.name: Seal of Command Retribution
retribution.basis: The familiar deep-Retribution build built around Vengeance and Seal of Command.
diverges: Vengeful Strikes has no vanilla counterpart and is the single biggest reason this build goes 36 points deep rather than stopping at 31.
Precision in the Protection tree grants hit, but is not taken here - the points buy more from Conviction and Vengeance.

beastmastery.name: Beast Mastery
beastmastery.basis: The classic deep-BM build ending in Bestial Wrath and Frenzy.
diverges: Kill Command is OctoWoW-only and sits behind two points in Spirit Bond.
The eighteen points go to Survival rather than Marksmanship, because Surefooted's 3% hit is worth more here than a partial Mortal Shots.

marksmanship.name: Marksmanship
marksmanship.basis: The standard Aimed Shot / Mortal Shots ranged build.
diverges: Experimental Ammunition, Piercing Shots and Lock and Load are all OctoWoW additions; Lock and Load is what makes going 33 deep worthwhile.
Surefooted is taken in Survival for its 3% hit, which counts against the gear hit budget the planner solves for.

survival.name: Survival
survival.basis: Vanilla Survival was a support tree; this leans on OctoWoW's expanded version of it.
diverges: Carve, Lacerate, Untamed Trapper and Killer Instinct have no vanilla equivalents - most of this build is OctoWoW-specific and is the least settled of the three hunter builds.
Mortal Shots is left at three of five because the points cannot reach further without giving up Untamed Trapper.

combat.name: Combat Swords
combat.basis: The 20/31/0 Adrenaline Rush build every vanilla rogue guide lands on.
diverges: Weapon Expertise replaces vanilla's Sword/Mace/Fist specialisations, so weapon choice no longer changes the build.
Surprise Attack, Blade Rush and Hack and Slash are OctoWoW-only; Blade Rush follows Surprise Attack.
Deflection is taken as the route to the fourth tier, not for the parry.

assassination.name: Assassination Daggers
assassination.basis: The Seal Fate / Cold Blood dagger build.
diverges: Envenom and Noxious Assault are OctoWoW-only; Noxious Assault sits behind Envenom.
Precision in Combat still supplies the 5% hit this build depends on, exactly as in vanilla.

subtlety.name: Hemorrhage Subtlety
subtlety.basis: The Hemorrhage build, which in vanilla was a PvP staple rather than a raid spec.
diverges: Tricks of the Trade, Mark for Death and Shadow of Death are OctoWoW additions and carry most of this build's value.
Blackjack and Improved Ambush take points purely to reach the fifth tier.

shadow.name: Shadowform
diverges: Vampiric Touch is OctoWoW-only and follows Vampiric Embrace.
Shadow Focus is five points of spell hit against shadow targets - the planner subtracts it from the hit it goes shopping for.

holy.name: Holy Healer
holy.basis: The classic Spiritual Guidance / Spiritual Healing raid healer.
diverges: Reservoir of Light and Book of Prayer are OctoWoW-only and are passed over here in favour of the vanilla core.
Divine Fury is kept at five even for a pure healer, as it is still the cheapest route through the second tier.

discipline.name: Discipline
discipline.basis: Vanilla had no raid-viable Discipline build; this is built from OctoWoW's rewritten tree.
diverges: Force of Will, Chastise, Enlighten, Resurgent Shield and Purifying Flames are all OctoWoW-only. This build is the least traditional of the three and the most worth arguing with.
Searing Light takes three points mainly to open the fourth tier.

elemental.name: Elemental
elemental.basis: The Lightning Mastery / Elemental Fury caster build.
diverges: Elemental Devastation grants hit on this server rather than vanilla's crit-after-crit effect - three points is 3% hit, and the planner counts it.
Earthquake and Improved Molten Blast are OctoWoW-only; Earthquake is taken, Molten Blast is not.

enhancement.name: Enhancement
diverges: Stormstrike is a single point in the fifth tier here rather than a 30-point capstone, which frees the deep points for Element's Grace and Bloodlust.
Lightning Strike needs three points in Stable Shields first, so Stable Shields is taken despite doing nothing for damage.
Elemental Devastation is taken for its 3% hit, not for damage.

tank.name: Shield Tank
tank.basis: Not adapted from vanilla - vanilla had no shaman tank. This is a real 12/39/0 build taken from a geared OctoWoW shaman tank and verified against the live talent calculator.
diverges: The whole spec is OctoWoW-only. Ancestral Guardian (+15% item armour, +6% dodge) and Spirit Armor (+30% shield armour) are the talents that make it work, and neither exists in vanilla.
Elemental Warding and Elemental Devastation split the Elemental points: mitigation plus the 3% hit that keeps threat abilities landing.

restoration.name: Restoration
restoration.basis: The Chain Heal build, tracking vanilla's Restoration core.
diverges: Spirit Link and Improved Water Shield are OctoWoW-only; Spirit Link is the capstone this build spends 36 points to reach.
No hit is taken anywhere - a healer never needs it, and the planner does not budget for any.

fire.name: Fire
diverges: Hot Streak is OctoWoW-only and follows Pyroblast.
Arcane Focus is deliberately skipped: its hit only applies to Arcane spells, so it does nothing for a Fire mage. The planner budgets full gear hit accordingly.

frost.name: Frost
diverges: Icicles and Flash Freeze are OctoWoW-only; neither makes the cut here.
Elemental Precision is three points of Fire and Frost hit, which the planner subtracts from the gear hit it looks for.

arcane.name: Arcane
arcane.basis: Vanilla had no deep-Arcane raid build; OctoWoW's tree supports one, so this is largely new.
diverges: Resonance Cascade, Temporal Convergence, Accelerated Arcana and Arcane Rupture are all OctoWoW-only. This is the least traditional mage build of the three.
Arcane Focus is worth taking here and only here, because Arcane is the school it applies to.

destruction.name: Destruction
diverges: Conflagrate requires five points in Improved Immolate here, which shapes the deep end of the tree.
Suppression is taken in Affliction for its 2% spell hit per rank - the planner counts it against the hit budget.

affliction.name: Affliction
diverges: Dark Harvest and Rapid Deterioration are OctoWoW-only; Dark Harvest is what justifies going 36 deep.
Suppression's five points are 10% spell hit against shadow targets, which is most of a caster's hit requirement on its own.

demonology.name: Demonology
diverges: Power Overwhelming, Unleashed Potential and Nether Studies are OctoWoW-only.
Demonic Precision is skipped on purpose: it grants the pet hit, not yours, so it does nothing for the gear budget.

balance.name: Moonkin Balance
balance.basis: The Moonkin Form / Nature's Grace caster build.
diverges: Eclipse, Balance of All Things and Gale Winds are OctoWoW-only and are what take this build to 36 points.
Improved Nature's Grasp requires a point in Nature's Grasp first, exactly as in vanilla.

feral.name: Feral Cat
feral.basis: The Heart of the Wild / Leader of the Pack cat build.
diverges: Carnage, Ancient Brutality, Open Wounds and Berserk are OctoWoW-only.
Genesis in Restoration grants 1% hit per rank, so three points there is 3% off what the gear has to find - the same role Precision plays for a rogue.

guardian.name: Guardian Bear
guardian.basis: The bear tank build, tracking vanilla's Feral core with more depth.
diverges: Thick Hide and Feral Instinct carry more weight here than in vanilla because OctoWoW's bear scales from item armour.
Genesis supplies 3% hit, which matters for holding threat rather than for damage.

restoration.name: Restoration
restoration.basis: The Gift of Nature / Improved Regrowth healer.
diverges: Tree of Life Form and Aessina's Bloom are OctoWoW-only; Tree of Life is the capstone this build reaches for.
Furor is kept even for a pure healer, as it is the cheapest way through the first tier.
